UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "classDiagram 

    class EntityBase {
        +DateTime CreatedAt
        +DateTime UpdatedAt
        +Guid CreatedById
        +UserEntity CreatedBy
    }

    class CarEntity {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +int Seats
        +decimal FuelConsumption
        +string RegistrationNumber
        +Guid DriverId
        +UserEntity Driver
    }

    class RouteEntity {
        +Guid Id
        +string StartAddressName
        +Point Start
        +string EndAddressName
        +Point End
        +double Distance
        +DateTimeOffset DepartureTime
        +DateTimeOffset ArrivalTime
        +Guid DriverId
        +UserEntity Driver
        +ICollection~ReservationEntity~ Reservations
    }

    class ReservationEntity {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid RouteId
        +RouteEntity Route
        +Guid PassengerId
        +UserEntity Passenger
        +ReservationStatus Status
        +Point PickupPoint
        +Point DropOffPoint
    }

    class RefreshTokenEntity {
        +Guid Id
        +string Token
        +DateTime ExpiresAt
        +Guid UserId
        +UserEntity User
    }

    class UserEntity {
        +RefreshTokenEntity RefreshToken
        +ICollection~ReservationEntity~ Reservations
        +ICollection~RouteEntity~ Routes
        +CarEntity Car
    }

    class RoleEntity {
    }

    class IdentityUser {
    }

    class IdentityRole {
    }

    class ReservationStatus {
        <<enumeration>>
        Pending = 0
        Accepted = 1
        Completed = 2
        Cancelled = 3
    }

    EntityBase <|-- CarEntity
    EntityBase <|-- RouteEntity
    EntityBase <|-- ReservationEntity
    IdentityUser <|-- UserEntity
    IdentityRole <|-- RoleEntity

    UserEntity "1" --> "0..1" RefreshTokenEntity 
    UserEntity "1" --> "0..1" CarEntity
    UserEntity "1" --> "0..*" RouteEntity
    UserEntity "1" --> "0..*" ReservationEntity
    RouteEntity "1" --> "0..*" ReservationEntity",
  "config": null,
  "version": "12"
}
